claim_scope: Post-hoc exploratory Train-only diagnostic on previously used dates; no candidate selection, adoption, or independent OOS claim.

trials.description: Pure 250-trading-day (52-week) high proximity prox250 EWMA(0.25), no momentum component

feature_definitions.res60s1: lag 1 sum of 60 observed residual returns per listing segment, min_periods=60, centered percentile rank in [-1, 1]
feature_definitions.prox250: centered daily rank in [-1, 1] of Close_t / rolling_max(raw High_t, 250 observed rows), min_periods=120
feature_definitions.P250: prox250 EWMA alpha=0.25, adjust=False, no momentum component
feature_definitions.smoothing: EWMA alpha=0.25, adjust=False per listing segment

model: Deterministic single-factor rank signal; no fitted parameters.

selection_rule.diagnostic_screen: Net Sharpe improvement folds >= 3/4; median delta Net Sharpe > 0; pooled Net Sharpe > H0
selection_rule.turnover_control: Turnover must not exceed 1.5x of H0 baseline
selection_rule.bootstrap_interpretation: Descriptive, unadjusted for candidate selection; not confirmatory inference
